description: A bearded man in a cream turban and dark waistcoat stands at a wooden board in a dim workshop, cutting a pale slab with a knife while dusting it with white powder. Trays of pink and amber cubes dusted with powder sit on the counter, with copper pots, a brass scale, a fire glowing in the background, and jars on shelves behind him. The painting is an oil style and fills the whole frame with no visible border, text or signature.
